name: wmis-agl-rwanda
description: Warehouse Management Information System for Africa Global Logistics Rwanda

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:open: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:open --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
